info.title: relay-guest-api: the reserved host cwd
info.summary: What the relay serves the build environment as http://cwd/: the build context.
info.description: The reserved host cwd of the relay's guest API, as a conforming build environment uses it. The requirements of relay-guest-api/v1.md are normative and this file describes only what they state. What it cannot say is in that document alone: routing by the request's target host (that of an absolute URL, or else the Host) whatever its port, on port 80 and inside TLS on port 443; the link below HTTP (DHCP, ARP, DNS); the ordering, completion as terminal, and the timing of the heartbeat; the differences by mode; and the known divergences. A context path may hold several segments: /{path} is one template whose parameter is marked x-multi-segment and whose rule is GUEST-33's. Only GET is served; another method is proxied (D10).

servers.description: Port 80 of the relay's address, or any address the build's connections reach the relay on (GUEST-17).
Port 443, through interception (GUEST-42); routed as on port 80.

200.description: The collector's listing of the context's root, byte for byte; not recorded.

get.summary: A file of the build context, or a listing of a directory

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The context path, one or more segments separated by unescaped slashes, with a trailing slash for a listing (GUEST-33).

200.description: A file, byte for byte and recorded, or a listing of a directory, byte for byte and not recorded, as the collector gives it.

403.description: forbidden, and a line feed: the path breaks the rule.
